caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wall clock with two main circular sections arranged vertically. The upper section features a large clock face with black Roman numerals and two black clock hands indicating the time. The face is surrounded by a decorative, rounded wooden frame adorned with gold-colored floral and leaf motifs. The lower section is slightly smaller, circular, and features additional ornamental woodwork with gold accents, including a central medallion displaying further decorative elements. The entire clock structure is composed of brown wood tones enhanced with gold colored embellishments, and the background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing clear contrast to the detailed clock.
title: Metal Wall Clock
